integrity: A complete finite combinatorial classification, a uniform logarithmic Laplace estimate with tail controls, and a finite entropy-gap comparison establish the asymptotics. Finite direct-map tests independently confirm small instances but are not substitutes for the limiting proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed block count r>=2, equal block size m tending to infinity; no statement for unequal block sizes, growth of r, or non-idempotents. The exact idempotent-character decomposition is pre-existing enumerative structure (Dolinka–East 2014); the asserted new mathematical claims are its strict-entropy asymptotic concentration, rare-event exponent and rare-character shape, plus logarithmic rank law. Search cannot establish global publication priority; the 2017 Al-aadhami thesis body remains unchecked.
title: One-block collapse and logarithmic rank of random idempotent partition endomorphisms
